arxiv-2112-07457.title: Triangulation candidates for Bayesian optimization
arxiv-2112-07457.creator: Robert B. Gramacy, Annie Sauer, Nathan Wycoff
arxiv-2112-07457.description: Abstract Bayesian optimization involves “inner optimization” over a new-data acquisition criterion which is non-convex/highly multi-modal, may be non-differentiable, or may otherwise thwart local numerical optimizers. In such cases it is common to replace continuous search with a discrete one over random candidates. Here we propose using candidates based on a Delaunay triangulation of the existing input design.

arxiv-2212-08954.title: Cascaded Compositional Residual Learning for Complex Interactive Behaviors
arxiv-2212-08954.creator: K. Niranjan Kumar, Irfan Essa, Sehoon Ha
arxiv-2212-08954.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by K. Niranjan Kumar, Irfan Essa, Sehoon Ha. Real-world autonomous missions often require rich interaction with nearby objects, such as doors or switches, along with effective navigation. However, such complex behaviors are difficult to learn because they involve both high-level planning and low-level motor control. We present a novel framework, Cascaded Compositional Residual Learning (CCRL), which learns composite skills by recursively leveraging a library of previously learned control policies.

arxiv-2306-07049.title: Strain engineering of the electronic states of silicon-based quantum emitters
arxiv-2306-07049.creator: A. Ristori, M. Khoury, M. Salvalaglio, A. Filippatos, M. Amato, T. Herzig, J. Meijer, S. Pezzagna, D. Hannani, M. Bollani, C. Barri, C. M. Ruiz, N. Granchi, F. Intonti, M. Abbarchi, F. Biccari
arxiv-2306-07049.description: Abstract Light-emitting complex defects in silicon have been considered a potential platform for quantum technologies based on spin and photon degrees of freedom working at telecom wavelengths. Their integration in complex devices is still in its infancy, and it was mostly focused on light extraction and guiding.

arxiv-2401-06576.title: Scalar Representation of 2D Steady Vector Fields
arxiv-2401-06576.creator: Holger Theisel, Michael Motejat, Janos Zimmermann, Christian Rössl
arxiv-2401-06576.description: Abstract We introduce a representation of a 2D steady vector field 𝐯 {\mathbf{v}} by two scalar fields a a , b b , such that the isolines of a a correspond to stream lines of 𝐯 {\mathbf{v}} , and b b increases with constant speed under integration of 𝐯 {\mathbf{v}} .

arxiv-2402-05985.title: Computational Fluid Dynamics: its Carbon Footprint and Role in Carbon Emission Reduction
arxiv-2402-05985.creator: Xiang I A Yang, Wen Zhang, Mahdi Abkar, William Anderson
arxiv-2402-05985.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xiang I A Yang, Wen Zhang, Mahdi Abkar, William Anderson. Turbulent flow physics regulates the aerodynamic properties of lifting surfaces, the thermodynamic efficiency of vapor power systems, and exchanges of natural and anthropogenic quantities between the atmosphere and ocean, to name just a few applications of contemporary importance. The space-time dynamics of turbulent flows are described via numerical integration of the non-linear Navier-Stokes equation – a procedure known as computational fluid dynamics (CFD).

arxiv-2404-07369.title: Origin of pinning disorder in magnetic-field-induced Wigner solids
arxiv-2404-07369.creator: Matthew L. Freeman, P. T. Madathil, L. N. Pfeiffer, K. W. Baldwin, Y. J. Chung, R. Winkler, M. Shayegan, L. W. Engel
arxiv-2404-07369.description: Abstract At low Landau level filling factors ( ν \nu ), Wigner solid phases of two-dimensional electron systems in GaAs are pinned by disorder, and exhibit a pinning mode, whose frequency is a measure of the disorder that pins the Wigner solid.

arxiv-2407-06417.title: Censorship of Quantum Resources in Quantum Networks
arxiv-2407-06417.creator: Julien Pinske, Klaus Mølmer
arxiv-2407-06417.description: Abstract We may soon see agencies offering public access to quantum communication networks. In such networks it may be a feature that certain resources are available only to priority users or at a higher user fee, as governed by a protective agency overseeing the communication in the network.

arxiv-2503-18756.title: Local Interference: Removing Interference Bias in Semi-Parametric Causal Models
arxiv-2503-18756.creator: Michael O’Riordan, Ciarán M. Gilligan-Lee
arxiv-2503-18756.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Michael O’Riordan, Ciarán M. Gilligan-Lee. Interference bias is a major impediment to identifying causal effects in real-world settings. For example, vaccination reduces the transmission of a virus in a population such that everyone benefits—even those who are not treated. This is a source of bias that must be accounted for if one wants to learn the true effect of a vaccine on an individual’s immune system.

arxiv-2510-04278.title: Integrated Planning and Control on Manifolds: Factor Graph Representation and Toolkit
arxiv-2510-04278.creator: Peiwen Yang, Weisong Wen, Runqiu Yang, Yuanyuan Zhang, Jiahao Hu, Yingming Chen
arxiv-2510-04278.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Peiwen Yang, Weisong Wen, Runqiu Yang, Yuanyuan Zhang, Jiahao Hu, Yingming Chen. Model predictive control (MPC) faces significant limitations when applied to systems evolving on nonlinear manifolds, such as robotic attitude dynamics and constrained motion planning, where traditional Euclidean formulations struggle with singularities, over-parameterization, and poor convergence. To overcome these challenges, this paper introduces FactorMPC, a factor-graph based MPC toolkit that unifies system dynamics, constraints, and objectives into a modular, user-friendly, and efficient optimization structure.

arxiv-2601-11949.title: A Deep Learning–Copula Framework for Climate-Related Home Insurance Risk
arxiv-2601-11949.creator: Asim K. Dey
arxiv-2601-11949.description: Abstract Extreme weather events are becoming more common, with severe storms, floods, and prolonged precipitation affecting communities worldwide. These shifts in climate patterns pose a direct threat to the insurance industry, which faces growing exposure to weather-related damages. As claims linked to extreme weather rise, insurance companies need reliable tools to assess future risks.

britannica-1911-struve-friedrich-georg-w.title: Struve, Friedrich Georg Wilhelm (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-struve-friedrich-georg-w.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-struve-friedrich-georg-w.description: Article 'Struve, Friedrich Georg Wilhelm' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Struve's name is best known by his observations of double stars, which he carried on for many years. These bodies had first been regularly measured by W. Herschel, who discovered that many of them formed systems of two stars revolving round their common centre of gravity. Herschel (and for some time Sir James South) had observed them, but their labours were eclipsed by Struve.

pmc-11492182.title: Pharmacists perspectives on challenges and facilitators in initiating medications take-back program in Indonesia: A qualitative study
pmc-11492182.creator: Sofa D Alfian, Annisa M Azzahra, Qisty A Khoiry, Meliana Griselda, Irma M Puspitasari, Rizky Abdulah
pmc-11492182.description: Objective:The establishment of a medication take-back program is an important intervention to prevent the improper disposal of expired or unused household medications. A significant step in establishing the program is to gain a better understanding of pharmacists’ perspectives on the associated challenges and facilitators.

uslaw-usc-t54-s312106.description: United States Code, Title 54 (National Park Service And Related Programs); Chapter 3121 (National Trust For Historic Preservation In The United States). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In carrying out its functions under this chapter, the National Trust may consult with the National Park System Advisory Board on matters relating to the selection of sites, buildings, and objects to be preserved and.
